text_en: In you, O Lord , I take refuge; let me never be put to shame.
text_cn: 上主，我托庇于你， 使我永不受羞耻！

text_en: In your righteousness deliver me and rescue me; incline your ear to me and save me.
text_cn: 求你照你的正义解救我， 求你侧耳听我，并拯救我。

text_en: Be to me a rock of refuge, a strong fortress, to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
text_cn: 求你作我避难的石壁，获救的堡垒； 因为你是我的磐石，我的堡垒，

text_en: Rescue me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and cruel.
text_cn: 我的天主，求你由邪恶人的手中将我救出， 由凶蛮横暴者的掌中将我救走。

text_en: For you, O Lord, are my hope, my trust, O Lord , from my youth.
text_cn: 因为，我主上主，你是我的期望， 你是我自幼唯一的仰仗。

text_en: Upon you I have leaned from my birth; it was you who took me from my mother’s womb. My praise is continually of you.
text_cn: 我自从在母胎中，就仰赖了你， 尚在母怀中，你就是我的托庇； 我全心的希望，时时寄托于你。

text_en: I have been like a portent to many, but you are my strong refuge.
text_cn: 许多人都把我视作妖怪， 你却作了我有力的仰赖。

text_en: My mouth is filled with your praise, and with your glory all day long.
text_cn: 我要满口赞颂你， 我要终日称扬你。

text_en: Do not cast me off in the time of old age; do not forsake me when my strength is spent.
text_cn: 在我年老时，求你不要抛弃我， 在我气力衰弱时，不要远离我。

text_en: For my enemies speak concerning me, and those who watch for my life consult together.
text_cn: 不然，我的仇敌必要对我说， 窥伺我命的人，互相私议说：

text_en: They say, “Pursue and seize that person whom God has forsaken, for there is no one to deliver. ”
text_cn: “天主已经舍弃了他， 你们追击他，捕捉他！ 因为无人再来救他。”

text_en: O God, do not be far from me; O my God, make haste to help me!
text_cn: 天主，求你不要远离我， 我的天主，请快来救我。

text_en: Let my accusers be put to shame and consumed; let those who seek to hurt me be covered with scorn and disgrace.
text_cn: 愿那些谋杀我命的人，走投无路， 愿那些设法害我的人，蒙受耻辱！

text_en: But I will hope continually, and will praise you yet more and more.
text_cn: 我仍不断地期望你，每日加倍地赞美你。

text_en: My mouth will tell of your righteous acts, of your deeds of salvation all day long, though their number is past my knowledge.
text_cn: 我的口要传述你的宽仁， 终日不断宣扬你的救恩，因为我不知它们的数额。

text_en: I will come praising the mighty deeds of the Lord God , I will praise your righteousness, yours alone.
text_cn: 我要称扬我天主的伟大奇能， 上主，我要传述你独有的宽仁。

text_en: O God, from my youth you have taught me, and I still proclaim your wondrous deeds.
text_cn: 天主，远自我幼年时，你已教导了我。 直至今日，我仍宣示你的微妙。

text_en: So even to old age and gray hairs, O God, do not forsake me, until I proclaim your might to all the generations to come. Your power
text_cn: 天主，即使我发白年老， 求你也不要离弃我， 直至我将你的威力宣示给这一代， 将你的奇能传述给下一代。

text_en: and your righteousness, O God, reach the high heavens. You who have done great things, O God, who is like you?
text_cn: 天主，你的仁慈直达天际， 天主，你行大事谁可比你？

text_en: You who have made me see many troubles and calamities will revive me again; from the depths of the earth you will bring me up again.
text_cn: 你曾使我经历许多困苦艰难， 现今仍然是你使我生活安全， 并提拔我脱离了地下的深渊。

text_en: You will increase my honor, and comfort me once again.
text_cn: 求你增加我的尊位， 求你再来给我安慰。

text_en: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praises to you with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
text_cn: 我的天主，我要弹琴，歌颂你的忠诚， 以色列的圣者，我要鼓瑟，向你歌颂。

text_en: My lips will shout for joy when I sing praises to you; my soul also, which you have rescued.
text_cn: 当我歌颂你时，我的双唇要欢腾， 我那为你所救的灵魂，也要欢腾。

text_en: All day long my tongue will talk of your righteous help, for those who tried to do me harm have been put to shame, and disgraced.
text_cn: 我的舌头也要终日伸述你的仁慈， 因为谋图伤害我的人蒙受了羞耻。
